description: This file provides utility functions for mapping status categories and arbitrary strings to color representations, primarily used in a frontend dashboard for consistent and distinguishable color coding across statuses and categories.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel-like HSL color from an input string, ensuring distinct hues for different strings which are suitable for dark backgrounds.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps a status string to a predefined theme color. If the status isn't recognized, it generates a deterministic color based on the string.
